usdRate.sourceName: Trading Economics, USD/CVE market rate, 29 October 2026
usdRate.note: Secondary source because the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026. The escudo is pegged to the euro at 110.265; World Bank 2025 average 97.86 per dollar. Locally amounts are written with the cifrão as decimal mark (1.000$00).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE), consumer prices, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: the INE site is a script-only app that could not be read. Annual inflation 2.7% in September 2026 (0.8% in August); World Bank 2025 average 2.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025 (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG); escudo pegged to the euro
inflation_projection.note: The escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 per euro), and inflation outside the 2022 shock has run near 1-3%, so 2% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Banco de Cabo Verde reference rate (taxa de referência)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source because the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026; reference rate 2.50%, unchanged in the October 2026 reading.

savings_account_rate.note: No typical savings-account rate could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month term-deposit rate could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No 1-year term-deposit rate could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026. The World Bank average deposit rate was 1.53% in 2025.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Cabo Verde
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 1.53% average for 2025 (1.67% in 2024); a fresher central bank figure could not be read because the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No recent Treasury bill (Bilhetes do Tesouro) auction rate could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Treasury bond yield could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026 and Trading Economics has no Cabo Verde bond yield.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Treasury bond yield could be read; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026 and Trading Economics has no Cabo Verde bond yield.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Cabo Verde, individual income determination (Category D, investment income)
tax_bank_interest.note: Investment income, including interest, is taxed at a flat 20% (page last reviewed 29 May 2026); interest on term deposits of Cabo Verdean emigrants is exempt.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Cabo Verde, individual income determination (Category D, investment income)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; interest on bonds, including Treasury bonds, is taxed at a flat 10% (page last reviewed 29 May 2026).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit-guarantee cover per depositor could be confirmed; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit-card rate was found; World Bank average lending rate was 7.75% in 2025.

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), taxed at 20%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for world shares in euro-pegged escudo terms, about the deposit rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), about 1.2% after the 20% tax
equity_return_base.note: Base case: the local stock exchange is very small with few listings and no long index record, so this follows a global index in escudo (euro) terms, capped at 4 points over the after-tax deposit rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Escudo-euro peg; World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025)
equity_return_high.note: High case: world shares near their long-run return in euro terms.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.note: Base case: long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year with a stable euro peg.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold prices as in 2019-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), PwC 20% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates falling further, below 1% after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), PwC 20% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the average deposit rate after the 20% interest tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: PwC: Treasury bond interest taxed at 10%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: listed Treasury bonds, taxed at 10%, at a few points above deposits.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found; the Banco de Cabo Verde site refused connections on 31 October 2026.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per 1,000 CVE of cover were found from the supervisor or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums per 100,000 CVE of cover were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025; Trading Economics CPI September 2026
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI could be read, so health costs are planned one point above the 2% general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025; Trading Economics CPI September 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI could be read, so education costs are planned slightly above the 2% general assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)
life_expectancy.note: 76.2 years in 2024 (men 73.1, women 79.4); UN WPP 2024 gives 76.6 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total, 17.0, is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 10.50 (2025, World Bank), 16.5 (2040) and 42.7 (2065, populationpyramid.net/cabo-verde/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Cabo Verde social security system: INPS old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: Men 65, women 60, after at least 15 years of contributions. Source describes the 2024 rules (older than 2025); no later change was found.

retirement_age_government.note: No official text giving the retirement age of civil servants could be read; civil servants hired since 2006 are covered by the INPS scheme.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), PwC 20% tax on interest
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposits after tax if rates fall further.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025), PwC 20% tax on interest
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: the average deposit rate after the 20% tax, so not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: PwC: Treasury bond interest taxed at 10%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in listed Treasury bonds taxed at 10%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits, a little in shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.53% (2025); equity base 5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, Treasury bonds and global shares, between the safe and equity base cases.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a larger share in global shares in a good decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The basic social pension (Pensão Social Básica) exists, but its current monthly amount was not given on the CNPS pages that could be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Centro Nacional de Pensões Sociais (CNPS), Pensão Social Básica: conditions
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Residents aged 60 or over whose household income is below the INE extreme-poverty line and who are not covered by any social security scheme; foreigners after 10 years of legal residence. Page last updated 2020 (older than 2025).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees could be confirmed from an official source; PwC and CLEISS describe none.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Cabo Verde social security system: INPS old-age pension
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory INPS pension for employees and the self-employed: 2% of the reference wage (best 10 of the last 15 years) per insured year, at most 80%, after 15 years of contributions; contributions 8.5% employee and 16% employer (PwC). No automatic indexation is described. Source is 2024 (older than 2025).

savings_account.note: Rates not published in a source that could be read.

fdr_3m.note: Rates not published in a source that could be read.

fdr_1y.note: Rates not published in a source that could be read.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the Treasury and sold mainly to banks; no recent rate could be read.

tbond_5y.note: Listed on the Cabo Verde stock exchange; interest taxed at 10% for individuals.

tbond_10y.note: Listed on the Cabo Verde stock exchange; no yield could be read.

equity_fund.note: No diversified retail investment fund was found; the local stock exchange has only a few listed shares.

gold.note: No retail market for investment gold bars or coins was found.

centralBank.name: Banco de Cabo Verde (BCV)
centralBank.note: Also supervises banks and insurers; site refused connections when checked on 31 October 2026.

insuranceRegulator.name: Banco de Cabo Verde, insurance supervision

oldAgeAllowance.name: Centro Nacional de Pensões Sociais (CNPS), Pensão Social Básica
